title: Commerce at Scale and the New Economy
primary_theme: Personal Finance Autopilot and Founder Market Fluency
founder_lessons: Know your market deeply enough to explain it simply to someone less familiar.
Bring a practical six-to-twelve-month operating view, not just a high-level vision.
Reach out to investors before a fundraise so the relationship is less transactional.
Show humility about the difficulty of the task ahead; arrogance is obvious and unappealing.
notable_quotes: Americans deserve to have their financial services optimized when the technologies exist to do that.
It's more important to be able to articulate that in a simple way,
The humility that you can display around that can go a really long way.
